|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-Odin_Nesloor_and_First_Aid-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-Odin_Nesloor_and_First_Aid-2022-07-05-a41bae9.png]], 5 July 2022) → [[File:V9-L-Odin_Nesloor_and_First_Aid-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-odinnesloorfirstaid.gif]], 10 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 3 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-odinnesloorfirstaid022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/odinnesloorfirstaid.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/odinnesloorfirstaid.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “First Aid”. Text: “If your character is about to be hit, use 1 Force (free if by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to prevent its forfeit from being reduced (and character is immune to Dr. Evazan) for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Disarmed. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel a ‘react.’ OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”

|rulings=* The destiny draw and cost are paid during initiation, and then responses (e.g. [[Sense]]) may take place.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json primary card data], record <code>209_21</code>. Earlier cited archive: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* If retargeted by [[Surprise]], it must EITHER select new characters to be transported OR select a new destination site.
* If using [[Surprise]] to choose new characters, the new characters may be at the same origin site or a different origin site, but it cannot include any of the original characters.
